verdict.rationale: Monday's developer docs describe a GraphQL API, an apps framework, open-source Vibe React components, and an MCP/agent SDK-like framework for building custom agents and integrations, suggesting real official building blocks for AI-native development. However, all evidence is vendor-authored docs with no independent/community confirmation of SDK maturity, and a probe shows the llms.txt endpoint 404s, hinting at gaps in AI-specific developer tooling.
